presence_rationale: Substantive financed-emissions disclosure: aggregated estimate for 8 sectors of Australian lending portfolio = 10,885,840 tCO2-e covering 50.7% of Group EAD as at 30 June 2021. PCAF-aligned methodology. CCCA signatory.
specificity_rationale: Names PCAF residential mortgages methodology, Sectoral Decarbonisation Approach (SDA) Services Buildings methodology aligned to Well Below 2C, NAB SBT (carbon neutral over a decade as first Australian bank), CCCA requirements, Equator Principles, oil and gas sector review with credit policy update, science-based GHG reduction target with 2015 baseline. Sector-specific decarbonisation targets to be published in 2022 reporting suite.
quantification_rationale: Reports SASB FN-CB-410b.1 directly: 10,885,840 tCO2-e attributable financed emissions across 8 Australian sectors. FN-CB-410b.2 partially: industry breakdown by sector with intensities (24.1 tCO2-e per $1M AUD financed average). FN-CB-410b.3: 50.7% of Group EAD coverage. 55% Scope 1+2 reduction since 2015 (target 51% by 2025). $56.3bn cumulative environmental financing. 34/100 largest emitting customers engaged on transition plans. SASB FN-CB-410b metrics directly disclosed.
